searchText: Hi, I am working on a stake pool manager and during onboarding of a validator we collect presigned voluntary exit messages and store them(encrypted messages) in a database. So whenever we want to exit, we can decrypt and broadcast. Will presigned voluntary exit messages expire at any point of time? Is there any other attack vectors or issues which we need to consider? They expire after two hard forks. They also can't be created until the validator is recognized on-chain, so can't be created at time of deposit. got it, thanks for confirmation <@144468805697929216> can we deposit 1ETH and create the voluntary exit message? This isn't a dev discussion, best to take it to https://discord.gg/X7YPVcE6 ok

So whenever we want to exit, we can decrypt and broadcast. Will presigned voluntary exit messages expire at any point of time? Is there any other attack vectors or issues which we need to consider?

excerpts.author: jgm
excerpts.content: They expire after two hard forks.  They also can't be created until the validator is recognized on-chain, so can't be created at time of deposit.
